prompts.slides: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: small illustration for a university slide deck, next to the Italian label Slide. Generate a polished minimal editorial illustration of two overlapping presentation slides: one main rounded rectangular screen/document with a simple indigo heading line, two short muted slate lines and one lime geometric chart; a second slide peeking behind. Crisp contemporary flat vector-like forms, very restrained, front view with a slight angle, indigo #4f46e5 outline, white and pale indigo fills, small lime #84cc16 accents. Soft very subtle shadow only beneath the objects. Centered compact composition with generous transparent margin. Real alpha transparency outside objects. No text, letters, words, digits, people, hands, 3D clay, paper craft, texture, gradients or background scene. Must be clearly readable at 100 pixels, professional graphic compatible with white rounded cards, gray #f3f4f6 slide background and Avenir typography.
